source_read: https://birdsbakery.com/pages/nutrition-and-allergen-data/<handle> (all 80 published items' own pages, plus 3 repeat pages, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, 1 request per 1.1 s; robots.txt allows /pages/). The nutrition block of every page is identical to the copy the script used on 2026-10-06. The index feed (item list) was not re-fetched.
notes: My own regex parse of every page matched the published kJ, kcal, protein, carbs, fat, saturates, sugars, fibre, salt and basis of all 80 items (only exception is deliberate: Mixed cheese & onion chia sandwich sugars left blank because the guide lists it twice with 2.4 g and 22.4 g). Allergens Contains + May contain matched on all 80 (Contains = the page's Allergens line; may = the 'May contain traces' sentence). Then checked each page's own ingredient text for allergen words missing from its Allergens line and found three clear contradictions, now held back in birds_bakery.py HOLD: BLT chia roll (ingredients list EGG, Allergens line has no eggs), Apple crumble danish (ingredients list Sodium Metabisulphite, sulphites only as may-contain) and Apricot & pumpkin seed flapjack (ingredients list Butter (MILK) and SULPHUR DIOXIDE, Allergens line is just Gluten). Script re-run from the (identical) cache with checked-on 2026-10-08; check_chain 0 errors, 0 warnings, audit 0 flags.
